nri-world.title: UIC Junior From India Tops Inaugural International Computer Science Competition
nri-world.excerpt: Soham Basanwar, a computer science junior at the University of Illinois Chicago, placed first in both the senior and US national categories and earned a Gold Honor among 4,300 competitors.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian international student's sweep of a global CS contest is a concrete diaspora education success story for families weighing US study.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: 'No One But God and My Fans': Dhanush Sidesteps BJP-Backing Talk Amid Political Debut Buzz
nri-world.excerpt: The Tamil star's one-line response, reported by News18, lands after a lotus motif on fan-gathering gifts, an RSS-meeting report and a Congress allegation of an 'Operation D' — while his five-film slate points away from politics.
nri-world.nri_angle: Tamil cinema's politics pipeline is followed closely by the Tamil diaspora; Dhanush is its biggest current question mark.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Trump Lights a Diya in the Oval Office as Governors Mark Diwali Across the US
nri-world.excerpt: President Donald Trump hosted a Diwali celebration in the Oval Office on Friday and was gifted a Hanuman Chalisa, while governors from Washington to Nebraska issued proclamations honouring Indian American contributions, ANI reported.
nri-world.image_caption: The Oval Office at the White House, photographed in 2017. President Donald Trump lit a diya in the Oval Office on Friday during the White House Diwali celebration.
nri-world.nri_angle: Diwali is now marked at the highest levels of US government, from a presidential diya-lighting in the Oval Office to gubernatorial proclamations in at least five states, a measure of the Indian American community's civic standing.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Diwali Enters State Capitols And City Halls Across Pacific Northwest
nri-world.excerpt: Five governors hosted first-ever official Diwali celebrations, 22 Washington cities lit lamps in council chambers, and President Trump marked the festival in the Oval Office.
nri-world.nri_angle: Official Diwali celebrations at five state capitols, 22 Washington city halls and the Oval Office mark formal civic recognition of nearly 200,000 Indian Americans in Greater Seattle alone and of the diaspora nationally.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Schumer Vows Democrats Will Block Any Right-Winger Trump Supreme Court Nominee
nri-world.excerpt: Two days after winning a decisive Senate majority, Chuck Schumer told the Associated Press Democrats will reject far-right nominees for the Supreme Court, lower courts and Cabinet — while refusing to say if he would hold a vacancy open until after the next presidential election.
nri-world.image_caption: The United States Supreme Court building in Washington at dusk. Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer has vowed to block any right-wing nominee President Trump puts forward for the court.
nri-world.nri_angle: Senate confirmation control affects federal courts and Cabinet agencies that shape immigration, employment and civil-rights decisions for Indian American families.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Six Governors, 22 Mayors Join First Pacific Northwest-Wide Diwali Series
nri-world.excerpt: Idaho, Nebraska, Montana, North Dakota and Washington hosted first-ever Diwali celebrations at capitols and governors' mansions, with Oregon closing the series in Salem on November 10.
nri-world.nri_angle: First-ever Diwali celebrations at five state capitols and governors' mansions, plus 22 Washington city ceremonies, give Pacific Northwest Indian-Americans formal state-level recognition, closing in Salem and Seattle on November 10.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

Final celebrations in Salem, Seattle City Hall, and King County Council

nri-world.title: Harmeet Dhillon Resigns as Justice Department Civil Rights Chief After Midterms
nri-world.excerpt: The India-born assistant attorney general is the first senior Trump official to leave since Democrats took the House and Senate. She says she was not asked to resign; CBS sources give a different account.
nri-world.nri_angle: Dhillon, born in India and one of the most senior Indian Americans in the administration, leaves a division whose cases on admissions, sports and elections directly affect Indian American families.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Seaport Museum Hosts Free Diwali Celebration in New York on November 10
nri-world.excerpt: Diya decorating, rangoli, puppet storytime and a dance workshop fill a free two-hour programme at 213 Water Street, presented with The Culture Tree and the Rubin Museum.
nri-world.image_caption: A hand sets a decorated diya-inspired candle among others floating in a pool during a Diwali celebration. The South Street Seaport Museum hosts its Diwali celebration in New York on November 10, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: A free, timed Diwali programme in Lower Manhattan gives New York diaspora families a complete festival outing, museum included, in a single evening.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: High Turnout Unseats Incumbents in Serbia, Brazil and US Elections
nri-world.excerpt: Student List ends 14 years of SNS rule in Serbia, Lula overturns a first-round deficit for a fourth term in Brazil, and US midterms post the second-highest turnout since 1914 as Democrats take Congress.
nri-world.image_caption: The Government of Serbia building during the protest of university professors and collaborators in June 2025. Serbia's student-backed Student List won the October 25 snap election with about 53% of the vote, ending 14 years of Serbian Progressive Party rule, according to the Jamestown Foundation and Reuters reporting.
nri-world.image_credit: Photo: Emilija Knezevic via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)
nri-world.nri_angle: For Indian-Americans, the US midterm flip to a Democratic Congress shapes the next two years of federal policy; the Serbia and Brazil results show the same high-turnout dynamic at work globally.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: BJP Attacks Sonia Gandhi Over Babri Remark in Memoir Interviews
immigration.excerpt: BJP spokesmen Sudhanshu Trivedi and Pradeep Bhandari accused Congress of an 'anti-Ram' face after Sonia Gandhi said she cried watching the 1992 Babri Masjid demolition, days before her memoir 'Belonging' is published on November 10.
immigration.image_caption: The Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. The mosque was demolished on December 6, 1992, at the site that is now home to the Ram temple.
immigration.nri_angle: The Ayodhya dispute remains one of the most closely followed stories in Indian politics for the diaspora, and the memoir-driven exchange revives it days before the book's November 10 release.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Australia Student Visa Changes Split Families and Force Offshore Applications
immigration.excerpt: Rules in force since 2 October 2026 bar most students from including family, abolish adding family after grant with no exemptions, and push further applications offshore — leaving students whose visas expire mid-course, and families planning to reunite, with hard deadlines.

sources.label: Law Council of Australia (Department of Home Affairs advice)
Australian Department of Home Affairs — Including or adding family members

immigration.nri_angle: India is neither a Pacific nor an ASEAN country, so most Indian students in Australia can include family only via the PhD, DFAT/Defence sponsorship or fully funded foreign government scholarship exemptions — and with onshore applications largely closed and family additions after grant abolished, Indian families must settle study, spouse and childcare plans before the first application is lodged.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Higher education applications processed within 16 days
Target net overseas migration by mid-2028

immigration.title: UK Budget 2026: Lower Going Rates, Two-Year Graduate Visa for Some
immigration.excerpt: The Budget promises 25th-percentile going rates from spring 2027, a two-year Graduate visa for graduates of qualifying universities, and an HPI route widened to the top 150 institutions — but the general threshold will rise, the PhD discount will go, and most detail is still unpublished.

sources.label: Hill Dickinson — Immigration changes hidden in the 2026 Budget
Paragon Law — UK Autumn Budget 2026 immigration changes

immigration.nri_angle: Indians are among the largest cohorts on the UK's Skilled Worker, Graduate and HPI routes, so the spring 2027 move to 25th-percentile going rates, the two-year Graduate visa for qualifying universities, and the HPI expansion to the top 150 institutions directly shape whether Indian graduates can stay, switch and settle in Britain.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Manitoba Invites 526 Workers in Draw 283, Led by Manufacturing and Farm Jobs
immigration.excerpt: The province's 22nd draw of 2026 sent 448 of its 526 Letters of Advice to Apply to people already working in Manitoba in natural resources, agriculture, manufacturing and utilities, with 60 days to file a full nomination application.
immigration.image_caption: An aerial view of a Manitoba community at sunset. Manitoba Draw #283 issued 526 Letters of Advice to Apply on November 5, 2026, most of them to workers already employed in the province.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian workers already employed in Manitoba's agriculture, manufacturing and utilities sectors were the target of this draw; invitees have 60 days to file a complete nomination application.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada Names the Pathways Behind Its 200,000 Extra PR Spaces for 2027
immigration.excerpt: IRCC will fill the one-time 2027 spaces from applications already in the system: provincial nominee workers and closed economic programs in one cohort of 100,000, and family and humanitarian cases in the other.
immigration.image_caption: The flag of Canada. IRCC has named the pathways that will fill 200,000 additional in-Canada permanent residence spaces in 2027.
immigration.nri_angle: Indians are among the largest groups of temporary residents in Canada; anyone with a pending PNP, caregiver, closed-program or in-Canada spousal application is in line for the extra 2027 processing space, with no new application needed.

immigration.title: India Waives $25 OCI Passport-Update Penalty Until December 31, 2026
immigration.excerpt: It is a one-time waiver, not a removal: late updates received between November 1 and December 31 escape the $25 penalty, which returns on January 1, 2027.
immigration.image_caption: An Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card (file photo). India has waived the 5 passport-update penalty until December 31, 2026.
immigration.nri_angle: Any OCI holder who renewed a foreign passport more than three months ago can file the overdue update free until December 31, 2026 — after that the $25 penalty applies again.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.step: File the update on the e-OCI portal
steps.detail: Submit the passport-particulars update online before December 31, 2026; the waiver covers updates received in the window.
The Government of India has clarified that OCI holders can travel to and from India while a delayed passport update is under process.

immigration.title: Judge Blocks Trump's 250-Foot Washington Arch Hours After Panel Approves It
immigration.excerpt: Judge Tanya Chutkan paused all construction at Memorial Circle for 14 days after the planning commission's 8-4 approval, in the fight over whether Congress ever authorised the monument.
immigration.nri_angle: The ruling freezes a contested change to the monumental core of Washington, DC, a city where many Indian-Americans work in federal service and visit Arlington and the Lincoln Memorial.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada Holds PR Target at 380,000, Opens Path for 200,000 Already There
immigration.excerpt: The 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan keeps admissions flat at 380,000 a year, but Budget 2026 adds a one-time transition to permanent residence for up to 200,000 temporary residents already in Canada by the end of 2027.
immigration.image_caption: Parliament Hill in Ottawa. Canada's 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan, released with Budget 2026, holds permanent resident admissions at 380,000 a year.
immigration.nri_angle: For Indians in Canada on work or study permits, the one-time transition for people already in the country is the one new opening in an otherwise flat plan.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: India Tightens Nepal, Bhutan Border Rules: Passport Now Needed for Third-Country Travel
immigration.excerpt: A Home Ministry amendment keeps direct India–Nepal and India–Bhutan travel passport-free but makes a Visa Manual identity document mandatory at immigration — and closes the route for using either neighbour as a passport-free bridge to a third country.

sources.label: The Times of India via 7Globe — Centre amends Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order: What Indians travelling to or returning from Nepal or Bhutan need to know
ANI via NewKerala — MHA Amends Immigration Order, Identity Documents Mandatory for India-Nepal-Bhutan Travel
PTI via News89 — Govt Relaxes Passport, Visa Norms For Select Foreigners, Refugees Living In India

immigration.nri_angle: Indians and NRIs who visit family or transit through Nepal and Bhutan must now show a specified identity document, and anyone routing to a third country through either border needs a passport and a designated immigration post.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: VIX Jumped 11.57 Points in a Day; History Says Six Months Later Stocks Were Usually Higher
markets-finance.excerpt: The fear gauge closed at 28.18 on November 5 as the S&P 500 fell 4.41% and the Nasdaq 100 dropped 6.5%. In Bespoke's 19 similar spikes since 1990, the S&P 500's median return six months later was 4.8%, positive 79% of the time — with a negative average over the first month.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Many diaspora investors hold US index and semiconductor exposure through 401(k)s and brokerages; the Bespoke table gives them the sourced historical odds, and the limits of those odds, after the year's sharpest fear spike.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Coca-Cola's India Bottler Files IPO in Pure Shareholder Sell-Down
markets-finance.excerpt: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings' draft prospectus offers up to 997.5 million existing shares; its majority owner cuts its stake to about 45% and the company gets no fresh funds.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Coca-Cola Tower, part of the Coca-Cola Company's headquarters complex (file photo). Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, the brand's largest bottler in India, has filed draft IPO papers with SEBI.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors who track Indian consumer listings, this is a large, familiar-brand offer to watch — but it is a parent sell-down, not a growth fundraise, and no price band exists yet.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Tata Steel Q2 Profit Rises 16% to Rs 3,700 Crore on India Strength
markets-finance.excerpt: Consolidated reported profit after tax rose 16.2% to Rs 3,699.59 crore in the September quarter as revenue from operations climbed 11.5% to Rs 65,436.24 crore and EBITDA reached Rs 10,665 crore.
markets-finance.image_caption: A Tata Steel plant is seen with the company name on a storage tank. Tata Steel reported second-quarter results on November 7, 2026.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Tata Steel's India-led earnings and Rs 91,423 crore net debt position matter for diaspora investors holding Indian steel and infrastructure exposure.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Berkshire Operating Earnings Fall 5.8% as Buybacks Hit $9.6 Billion
markets-finance.excerpt: Third-quarter operating earnings slipped to $12.705 billion on weaker insurance results, while Berkshire more than doubled buybacks to $9.6 billion and its shares rose more than 5% in a week when the S&P 500 fell almost 2.7%.
markets-finance.image_caption: A display shows Berkshire Hathaway Inc. listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Berkshire reported third-quarter operating earnings and a $9.6 billion share buyback on Saturday.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Berkshire's defensive earnings mix and record buybacks offer a contrast for diaspora investors concentrated in AI-heavy technology stocks.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Sensex's 10.6% Seven-Session Pre-Diwali Rally Is Its Strongest in 35 Years
markets-finance.excerpt: The Sensex closed at 81,028 and the Nifty reclaimed 25,000 on Friday as foreign investors poured in about Rs 49,500 crore, crude slid and the market posted its best week since February 2021.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A record pre-Diwali rally matters directly to diaspora investors holding Indian equities and mutual funds.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Europe's Rearmament Turned Indian Shells Into a Rs 38,000 Crore Export Story
markets-finance.excerpt: India's defence exports hit a record Rs 38,424 crore in FY2025-26, and Bloomberg's trade-data analysis shows at least $872 million of Indian shells, mortars and explosives shipped to Europe since 2022.
markets-finance.image_caption: A 155mm howitzer shell (file photo). Indian firms have shipped artillery shells, mortar rounds and explosives to Europe in sharply higher volumes since 2022, trade data analysed by Bloomberg shows.
markets-finance.nri_angle: India's emergence as a major ammunition supplier to Europe is a markets story for diaspora investors tracking Indian defence stocks.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Gold Has Risen Fivefold in a Decade; Motilal Oswal Sees Rs 1.68 Lakh Ahead
markets-finance.excerpt: Motilal Oswal's quarterly bullion report expects domestic gold at Rs 1.60-1.68 lakh per 10 grams within 6 to 12 months, against about Rs 30,000 at Diwali 2016 and around Rs 1.5 lakh this Dhanteras.
markets-finance.image_caption: Native gold crystals. Motilal Oswal expects domestic gold to reach Rs 1.60 lakh to Rs 1.68 lakh per 10 grams within 12 months.

sources.label: Tezzbuzz — Motilal Oswal precious metals targets

markets-finance.nri_angle: Gold buying on Dhanteras is a fixed ritual for many diaspora families, whether in India or through jewellers abroad; a fivefold decade rise to about Rs 1.5 lakh per 10 grams, with a brokerage target of Rs 1.68 lakh, changes the size of that annual decision materially.

markets-finance.title: Nvidia, AMD and Micron Lead Chip Rebound After Worst Selloff Since 2020
markets-finance.excerpt: AMD closed up 11%, Intel 8% and Micron 5% on Friday, recovering only part of a November 5 rout in which the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.25%, its steepest drop since March 2020.

sources.label: AI Stock Wire (Yahoo Finance and Nasdaq index data)

markets-finance.nri_angle: Chip stocks are core holdings in many diaspora portfolios and retirement accounts, and Friday's partial rebound after a 12.25% index fall leaves investors who bought the AI trade still well below recent highs.

markets-finance.title: Charter Communications Q3 Results: Revenue Rises to $14.92 Billion as Impairment Drives Loss
markets-finance.excerpt: Reported revenue rose 9.1% on the Cox deal, but a $6.33 billion franchise impairment swung Charter to a $2.4 billion loss; on a pro forma basis revenue fell 1.5% as Internet losses widened to 233,000.
markets-finance.image_caption: Charter Communications headquarters in Stamford, Connecticut. The cable operator reported third-quarter revenue of $14.92 billion.

sources.label: Charter Communications — Third Quarter 2026 Results (PR Newswire)

markets-finance.nri_angle: Spectrum is the home broadband and mobile provider for millions of US households, including diaspora families; its pricing, mobile growth and service changes land directly on household bills.

markets-finance.title: Airbnb Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Rises 19% to $4.87 Billion in Q3 Results
markets-finance.excerpt: Airbnb's Q3 diluted EPS of $3.16 topped the $2.85 consensus as revenue beat forecasts, gross booking value rose 21% to $27.7 billion, and the company raised its full-year growth outlook to the high teens.
markets-finance.image_caption: Airbnb headquarters in San Francisco. The company beat third-quarter estimates as revenue rose 19% to $4.87 billion.

sources.label: Airbnb Q3 2026 Shareholder Letter (SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

markets-finance.nri_angle: Airbnb is a staple booking platform for diaspora family travel to and from India; firm international demand and the raised outlook signal travel spending held up into the holiday season.

markets-finance.title: Angel One Overtakes Zerodha as India's Second-Largest Broker as Groww Pulls Ahead
markets-finance.excerpt: NSE data for October 2026 shows Angel One added 2.43 lakh active clients to reach 69.98 lakh, passing Zerodha's 67.59 lakh, while Groww added 3.04 lakh clients and extended its lead at the top.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors holding demat accounts in India, the broker reshuffle is a practical prompt to compare platforms on NRI onboarding, charges and support, not just headline client rankings.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: CBI Books Kishore Biyani, Future Retail in Rs 904 Crore SBI Fraud Case
markets-finance.excerpt: India's Central Bureau of Investigation registered the case on November 4 on a State Bank of India complaint and searched premises linked to Future Retail's promoters in Mumbai on Friday, alleging loan funds were diverted through associate companies.
markets-finance.image_caption: Kishore Biyani is pictured alongside the Central Bureau of Investigation headquarters gate in an NDTV Profit graphic. The CBI has booked Biyani and Future Retail in an alleged Rs 904 crore State Bank of India loan fraud case.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors who tracked Future Retail and Big Bazaar as symbols of India's organised-retail boom, the CBI case is a major test of lender recovery and governance in a group already ordered into liquidation in 2024.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Jaiswal Smashes Second Straight Century for India A in New Zealand
sports.excerpt: The opener's 102 at Lincoln follows his unbeaten 155 at Hagley Oval — a timely return to form 12 days before India's Test series opens in Wellington.
sports.nri_angle: Jaiswal's form is the lead story for diaspora fans planning to watch the Wellington Test — India's opener arrives at the series with consecutive hundreds behind him.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Taniya Wins Silver in Beach Wrestling's Youth Olympic Debut at Dakar
sports.excerpt: The Indian wrestler lost the women's 75kg final 1-2 to China's Zhao Min after four straight wins — becoming the first Indian to medal in the sport at a Youth Olympics.
sports.nri_angle: An Indian teenager's silver in a brand-new Olympic discipline is the kind of first a diaspora audience follows closely — Indian wrestling keeps producing new names on new stages.

sports.excerpt: The Madhya Pradesh left-arm spinner took 6 for 22 against Andhra Pradesh in the Senior Women's T20 Trophy, days after taking nine wickets in two ODIs against Zimbabwe on her India return.
sports.image_caption: Vaishnavi Sharma celebrates while playing for India. The left-arm spinner took 6 for 22, including four wickets in four balls, for Madhya Pradesh in the Senior Women's T20 Trophy.
sports.nri_angle: Vaishnavi Sharma's comeback and record domestic spell are a rising-star story for Indian women's cricket fans in the diaspora following the national team's spin pipeline.

sports.excerpt: New Zealand were bowled out for 134 in Wellington, their lowest home ODI total against India, before rain ended India's chase at 113 for 7 — four runs ahead of the DLS par score.
sports.nri_angle: A young Indian pacer's breakout spell in New Zealand conditions is the kind of series moment diaspora fans follow ball by ball.

sports.title: Khalid Jamil Names 23-Man India Squad For New Zealand Friendlies
sports.excerpt: Hrithik Tiwari, Som Kumar and Vishal Kaith are the goalkeepers for the November 12 match in Auckland and November 15 match in Christchurch, with Gurpreet Singh Sandhu left out and three players pulled from the SAFF Championship squad.
sports.image_caption: India head coach Khalid Jamil oversees a national team training session. Jamil has named a 23-man squad for India's November friendlies against New Zealand in Auckland and Christchurch.
sports.nri_angle: India's first-ever men's tour of New Zealand brings the Blue Tigers to Auckland on November 12 and Christchurch on November 15, giving the Indian community in New Zealand a rare chance to see the national team play in their own cities.

sports.excerpt: Aaryavir Sehwag made 70 not out and captain Lakshya Raichandani 53 not out as India chased 129 in 19.1 overs, after bowling Nepal out for 128 in their U-19 Asia Cup opener in Al Amerat.
sports.nri_angle: For diaspora fans following India's next generation, the opener gave a first tournament look at Aaryavir Sehwag and captain Lakshya Raichandani, with India's next Group A match against Pakistan on Sunday.

sports.image_caption: Mohammed Shami in India colours. The fast bowler has retired from Test cricket after 64 matches and 229 wickets.

sports.title: Mike Hussey Joins Australia's Coaching Ranks for Ashes, World Cups and LA Olympics
sports.excerpt: The former batter will consult for the 2027 Ashes and ODI World Cup and advise on T20 through the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and T20 World Cup — after turning down an approach from England.
sports.nri_angle: Hussey's eight years as Chennai Super Kings batting coach made him a familiar figure to Indian fans; his next chapter is with Australia against, among others, India.

sports.title: Devon Conway Ruled Out of India ODI Series With Concussion; Nick Kelly Called In
sports.excerpt: Conway and Matt Henry collided at fielding practice before the Auckland opener. Henry has been cleared for Saturday's second ODI in Wellington; Conway will miss the remaining four matches.
sports.nri_angle: India's ODI tour of New Zealand continues in Wellington on Saturday — the second of five matches, with India 1-0 up after Auckland.

sports.title: Jaypal Malviya Wins World Silver, Secures India's First LA 2028 Quota
sports.excerpt: The little-known pistol shooter scored 242.2 in the Doha final behind China's Hu Kai, and India's women took team silver the same morning.
sports.image_caption: Jaypal Malviya, left, holds his silver medal on the podium at the ISSF World Championships in Doha, with gold medalist Hu Kai of China, centre, and bronze medalist Jindrich Dubovy of Czechia. Malviya's second place secured India's first quota place for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
sports.nri_angle: Malviya's quota opens India's Los Angeles 2028 account — the Games diaspora fans in the US will host in their own backyard.

food.title: Kaju Katli for Diwali: Cashew, Sugar and Ghee, Cut Into Diamonds
food.excerpt: The classic cashew fudge needs three ingredients and one judgement call — the one-string syrup. Two tested recipes, the powder method, and how long it keeps.
food.nri_angle: Every ingredient is available in a US supermarket: raw unsalted cashews, white sugar and ghee, with cardamom and optional silver leaf from an Indian grocery.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

steps: Powder the cashews in a dry mixer in one stretch. Do not grind too long — over-grinding makes the powder oily.
Boil the sugar with the water, stirring, until the syrup reaches one-string consistency: a drop stretched between finger and thumb forms a string that does not break.
Lower the flame completely and add the cashew powder, stirring continuously for 3 to 4 minutes until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides of the pan.
Test a tiny portion between greased fingers: you should be able to roll a soft, non-sticky ball.
Transfer the warm mixture to a greased tray or parchment and knead gently until the grainy dough turns smooth, sprinkling a little milk only if it is dry.
Roll into a thin layer and cut diagonally into diamond shapes. Cool completely before removing the pieces.

items.text: Buy only from licensed or registered shops and verify the FSSAI licence number displayed at the establishment
Ask for a bill carrying the shop's FSSAI number
Be cautious with unusually cheap sweets, khava, ghee and dry fruits, and avoid products with unnaturally bright colours, sour smells, stickiness or visible fungus
Buy milk-based sweets in small quantities, refrigerate them, and consume within a day or two
For online orders, check seals and expiry dates at delivery and refuse perishables that arrive warm, expired, damaged or tampered with
Report food-quality complaints on the FDA toll-free number 1800 222 3365 or its grievance portal
